selection_context: This second study is proposed AFTER observing MAT03 301..305 on the same digits dataset, so is a post-discovery replication of a known result, not a first untouched evaluation.
methods: all nine MAT03 methods unchanged; single shared 64-128-32 feature encoder K5 outputs; 400 updates, AdamW lr0.002, no data modifications

comparisons.H1: Four-coefficient Hadamard-exponential Mirror is better than 4-coefficient Hadamard-linear output chart on each same-input 5-task world. Predeclared margin: mean heldout NLL difference mirror minus linear <=-0.01 in at least 4/5 fresh seeds.
comparisons.H2: Mirror alone reaches native five independent one-pass heads within +0.02 NLL while whole serialized output bank <=.90 native bytes, with p95 <=1.10× native. If false, no full native-frontier win.
comparisons.H3: Mirror+private rank1 reaches native native_multihead within +0.02 NLL but saves >=5% whole serialized bytes and <=1.10 p95. If false, report the relative quality/size/time tradeoff, not adopted.
comparisons.H4: Every method executes exactly one trunk call per input, all 5 classification targets measured, and no labels from heldout image IDs are used for training/preprocessing/statistic thresholds.

fresh_measurements: actual NPZ file bytes including shared encoder and learned heads
CPU P95 B128 same inputs for each K role, 20/100 warmups/repeats
limitations: Five new splits of same 1797 digits, not independent datasets; checkpoint training rerun, not identical hardware clocks. No natural-language benchmark, no real GPU/TabM/LoGo replication. Native normal shared-head already one forward.
evidence_contract: source/test hashes pinned before fresh, save all 45 rows plus per-role metrics and verification hashes. Do not modify original source or original MAT03 results.
